name: Dimapur
description: Largest city and commercial hub of Nagaland, serving as the primary gateway with the state's only airport and major railway station. Located on the Dhansiri River plains near the Assam border; base for exploring Kachari heritage and nearby nature sites.
facts: Only airport and major railhead in Nagaland
Ancient capital of the Dimasa Kachari kingdom
Requires Inner Line Permit for visitors from outside Nagaland
Elevation about 145 m on Dhansiri River plains

name: Kachari Ruins (Dimasa Kachari Monoliths)
description: Medieval archaeological site featuring mushroom-domed sandstone pillars and brick ruins from the 10th–13th century Dimasa Kachari kingdom capital. Located in the heart of Dimapur near the railway station; protected by ASI.
facts: Remnants of Dimasa Kachari capital before Ahom conquest
Unique mushroom-shaped pillars with carvings
Best visited October–March
Near Dimapur Railway Station

name: Nagaland Science Centre
description: Interactive science museum and planetarium promoting scientific awareness with galleries on senses, fun science, and children's exhibits. Located behind Naga Arcade in Half Nagarjan, Dimapur.
facts: Established 2004 under Department of Science & Technology
Includes Taramandal planetarium
Open 10 AM–4 PM, closed Mondays
Entry fee nominal; ideal for families

name: Hong Kong Market
description: Bustling flea market in central Dimapur known for affordable imported clothing, footwear, electronics, and goods from Myanmar, Thailand, and China. Popular shopping destination for locals and visitors.
facts: Grew from Tibetan trader stalls in the 1980s
Bargaining common; wide range of winter garments
Central location near major roads
Open roughly 10 AM–7 PM

name: Dimapur Jain Temple
description: Digambar Jain temple dedicated to Lord Mahavira, established in 1947 by migrant Jain families from Kohima. Features intricate glasswork and multiple tirthankara statues; located on Jain Temple Road.
facts: Built in 1947 after families relocated from Kohima during WWII
Moolnayak is Lord Mahavira
Managed by SD Jain Samaj Dimapur
Open daily

name: Dimapur Ao Baptist Church
description: Prominent Baptist church serving the Ao Naga community in Dimapur, reflecting the strong Christian tradition among Naga tribes. One of the larger churches in the city with community activities.
facts: Founded around 1958 with small congregation, now thousands of families
Key spiritual landmark in multi-tribal Dimapur
Active in community and mission work
Located in River Belt / Duncan Basti area

name: Dhansiri River (Dimapur section)
description: Major river flowing through the plains of Dimapur, offering riverside walks, birdwatching on sandbars, and scenic views near the Assam border. Important for local ecology and recreation.
facts: Key waterway of the Dimapur plains
Popular for winter birdwatching and evening walks
Near the commercial hub and railway line
Best in cooler months
